title: Define proposed Mock-only DAILY observation read contract
prohibited_actions: No HTTP request, ObserverOS API, database, credential, media, camera, RTSP/NVR, deployment, or browser media access
No person, customer, appointment, raw observation, raw event, image, video, source URL, device identifier, location detail, alert detail, or security conclusion fixture
No business calculation, priority decision, automatic patrol, permission decision, or authoritative state
No DAILY page or media-slot implementation
acceptance: Contract defines PROPOSED/MOCK-ONLY daily-observation request and safe response envelope
Data is null for denied, empty, pending, stale, error, or unknown paths and all presentation states remain distinct
Any future media is represented only as an opaque authorized reference with expiry and redaction semantics; no browser URL or media content is permitted
Allowlist excludes raw observation, identity, event detail, device detail, and external source fields
Verification proves no network primitive, no forbidden fixture field, and no claim of an existing ObserverOS API
Typecheck, production build, control-plane validation, GitHub audit, and receipt pass
